gaps.name: solar_panel_mast_1: a 6 m pole on a 10 cm foot falls when dropped
gaps.reason: Its model is a bare pole 6 m tall, 17 cm across and 10 cm across at its foot, laid standing on flat ground; as laid it stands (its weight inside its foot), but the drop topples it (moves 4.41 m and turns 90 degrees, output 6930a964f029, 2026-11-12), as any pole that narrow does. A mast is set in its ground, and the design's reading names no row fixed, so the drop judges it loose; no footing within the model holds it, and laid down it would no longer be a mast. It failed the assembly's resting gate as made and on its free remake (2026-11-12), so it is old_station's one gap: this entry moves its drop fault alone from the assembly's resting gate to complete, which fails it by name; every other fault still stops the line.
gaps.decided: owner (@JoeyKardolus), his standing rules of 2026-11-09 ("EVERY FAIL GETS ONE PAID RETAKE, IF FAIL AGAIN, GAP") and of env1's film (at most one gap object a place), applied by the old_station resting fix, 2026-11-12
